chief_complaint: Follow-up after myocardial infarction with uncontrolled hypertension and cardiovascular risk management
history_of_present_illness: The patient suffered an acute NSTEMI on 2021-03-25 and has a documented history of myocardial infarction since 2021-03-26. Since then he has been maintained on dual antiplatelet therapy, a beta‑blocker, ACE‑I/ARB with thiazide, and a low‑dose statin. Blood pressure remains elevated (160/96 mmHg) indicating stage 2 hypertension. He has diabetic kidney disease and chronic kidney disease stage 1 diagnosed in 2022, as well as chronic anemia and major depressive disorder. Prediabetes is listed, yet he is on insulin therapy with a very low recent A1c of 3.3%, raising concern for hypoglycemia. Recent encounters include a medication review (2024-08-05) and a social finding of being not in the labor force (2024-10-07). Overall, the patient has high cardiovascular and renal risk with multiple comorbidities and moderate polypharmacy.
